entry.title: Torre del Mangia
entry.note: Exact-QID tower outline supplies center and axis. Independently mapped chapel way252463679 lies on native -Z toward the Campo, fixing the signed front and the attached footprint. Primary city photos confirm the clock and chapel face. The mapped crown envelope is wider than the published square shaft; native dimensions are retained without footprint stretching. The surrounding Palazzo Pubblico is a separate building. Ground elevation is terrain contact; small court/piazza level differences are not surveyed. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
